summary:
R4's bullpen_fatigue is the standout signal today, running hot at +5.3pts over baseline (82-78, 51% last 14 vs 46% season 172-202), and that's a category worth weighting on a night with 15 games. All four ratings remain locked in strong-play mode with real money behind it — R1 is 45-21 (+31.0u) over 14 days and a scorching 23-7 (+19.0u) in the last week, while R4 posts the best 30-day ROI of the group at 101-55 (+52.0u, 65%). Trends+SP (57.5%, n=593) and trends+runs (57.0%) remain the top category combos when hunting for confirmation on today's board.

The slate itself is loaded with unanimous 4-rating consensus plays, and the strongest average delta belongs to LAD over SFG, where all four models stack from +1.96 to +3.16 — exactly the kind of spot to lean on given LAD's league-best strong-play record when liked (26-6, 81%, +26.0u). CLE over ATH is nearly as clean (+1.58 to +2.05 across all four) and pairs well with the trends+sp combo strength. TEX over TOR against deGrom is a full sweep too (+1.50 to +2.04), and PIT over KCR clears +1.3 on every rating. Fade spots matter just as much: NYY on the road at ARI is a unanimous negative lean (-1.61 to -1.91), consistent with NYY's ugly strong-play mark this year (8-13, -4.0u) — avoid forcing that side even if the raw score tempts. MIL @ BAL is the day's biggest team-trap: all four ratings lean against MIL (-1.15 to -2.21) despite MIL's strong 65% overall pick record (40-22, +14.0u), so this reads as a spot where recent BAL form is overriding season equity — treat as a fade, not a bet-against-the-model spot. The lone split board is WSN/STL, where R1-R3 favor STL (+0.16 to +0.37) but R4 flips to WSN at a near-zero -0.02 — thin enough delta on both sides to pass or minimum-unit only.
